title: Adding Text
description: Type text at the cursor, style it from the Text section, and apply a saved style preset.

bubble.title: Text, typed at the cursor
bubble.body: Text here is typed at the cursor, like everything else is drawn — no text boxes to drag first. The Text section holds its font, size, weight, spacing, and saved styles.

bubble.title: Three kinds of text
bubble.body: Display text is a single line at the cursor. Body text flows inside a frame you draw. And text can ride along a path. This tutorial uses Display; the others start from the same section.

bubble.title: Watch: type and style
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program steers to a spot, presses P, types a word, places it with Enter, then makes it bold with wider tracking.

demo.title: Typing at the cursor
demo.body: Steering to a spot. P is the Type At Cursor key.

demo.title: Placing it
demo.body: Enter places the line. The text is now an object on the page — and still text.

demo.title: Styling it
demo.body: Bold, with tracking opened up — set in the Text section while the text is selected.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: Typed and styled. It stays editable: double-click it later and type again.

bubble.title: Your turn: press P
bubble.body: Steer where your text should start, then press P — Type At Cursor.

bubble.title: Type your headline
bubble.body: Type a word or two, then press Enter to place the line on the page.

bubble.title: Make it bold
bubble.body: Your text is still selected, so the Text section is showing its style. Set Weight to Bold — the selected text repaints bolder.

bubble.title: Apply a style preset
bubble.body: Press Escape to deselect. In the Text section's Style preset, choose Headline and click Apply. With nothing selected, the preset becomes the creation style — the next text you type starts at 48pt, bold.

bubble.title: Text stays text
bubble.body: Text remains text — editable, restylable, searchable — until you deliberately convert it with Object ▸ Convert Text to Outlines. Styles you invent can be saved next to the built-in ones in the same preset row.
